meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会先搜索相关文档和示例，然后制定分阶段实施计划，每个阶段包含具体任务、文档引用和验证清单，最后进行整体验证。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步骤实现时，尤其是在执行具体操作之前。

say.text: 帮我规划实现用户登录功能
say.note: Claude 会先查找相关文档，然后制定分阶段计划。

say.text: 计划一下如何重构这个模块
say.note: Claude 会分析现有代码和文档，给出实施步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will search relevant docs and examples, then create a phased implementation plan with tasks, doc references, and verification checklists, followed by final verification.
howto.when_en: When you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan the implementation of user login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will search docs and create a phased plan.

say_en.text: Plan how to refactor this module.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze code and docs, then give steps.
